estimates.data_volume_note: Float32 uncompressed value-array estimate; excludes NetCDF metadata/compression and counts Cartesian pressure combinations.

geometry.area_construction: per track×UTC day; union of centered 5° patches; bounds rounded outward to 0.25°
geometry.longitude_wrap: smallest circular interval; CDS API west>east used across the dateline

predictors.relative_humidity_700: derive from temperature and specific_humidity at 700 hPa
predictors.vorticity_850: derive from u_component_of_wind and v_component_of_wind at 850 hPa
predictors.wind_shear_850_200: u_component_of_wind and v_component_of_wind at 850 and 200 hPa

pressure.note: CDS variable/level selection is Cartesian; extra combinations are explicitly counted.
